If the price is not appropriate for the request, you can use Skeb appeal to increase the price.

Thank you for considering my request!

My name is díː, an indie game creator, and I usually enjoy seeing your detailed and stylish illustrations. I would like to send a request to Mr. Jewel the Scribe Bird.

The contents of the request
I would like you to design a costume for Willian of my work Alternative Alliance Alpha (AL2α).

Usage
Display on my SNS account and website
Reference design for my games and illustrations
Use in my own games.

Supplemental information on usage
Although the game is currently a free game, there is a possibility that it will be charged for in the future, and since I have already released another commercial work, it will be used for commercial purposes as well.
When referring to the original design, we may omit or change the design depending on the pattern or seasonal events.
We will not use the illustration itself for the production of goods, but we may use the illustration drawn in reference to the design we receive to produce goods.

◆Details of the character
Height: about 180cm, body: slender
The skin is visible in the part of the body that imitates a crow (bird) (inside is human and wears a full body suit).
His personality is calm and his tension is always low. He is always calm and low tension. He is good at taking care of people. Eats well.

Requests
Shoes and coat suitable for long term outdoor activities in rough desert (low temperature and humidity, not below zero).
No head protection needed, as the crow's head is a substitute for a helmet.
Futuristic design (technology can reduce the weight and size of elements that would be heavy equipment today).
The colors are mainly achromatic and cold colors.
Large backpacks on the back (for carrying goods and souvenirs)

◆Documents
Willian's current design
https://dear-done-dead.games/materials/al2alpha_willian.png
Main body of the game
https://unityroom.com/games/al2alpha

Please cancel if there are any problems. Thank you for your consideration.

Good evening.
I have been a fan since Rikku☆Jia~s Type 90 Tank II, Chieftain Mk.11, etc.

The illustration I would like to request is an anthropomorphic illustration of the Trojan AVRE, a British Army combat engineer vehicle.
For details,
The base Trojan AVRE is equipped with a mine clearance plow on the front of the body.
The gender is female, and I would like her to have a calm face. I would like her to have a calm face, like the one of Katsuta Higashi, a garrison girl, in the initial draft.
We would be very happy if her physique is slightly muscular, but has a rich feminine silhouette.
We will leave it up to you to decide how much or how little skin to expose, but it would be better if the exposed skin has some light old scars.
As for the clothing, we would prefer a jacket and sports bra for the upper body and combat uniform and half boots for the lower body, as in Katsuta Azuma's initial proposal. However, if light clothing is not appropriate for the concept of a combat-uniformed engineering vehicle, please use the upper and lower body as combat uniform.
The color of the body should be khaki green. The hair and skin color should be similar to Chieftain Mk.11 of "Rick-Jee-A-Su.
As for the bundle of iron pipes, we will leave it up to you whether or not to draw it. However, if you can draw it, it would be preferable if it is grasped by a shovel arm.
I would like to see a shovel arm on the right shoulder, a plow on the right arm, and an L94A1 chain gun in the left hand, which would be more like a Trojan AVRE.
The above are just my requests, so I will leave the coloring and composition of the body to you.

If you can draw the illustration, I would like to use it as a standby image on my smartphone or in my X-account image.
Thank you in advance for your consideration.
